about: Official HDB visual resources shown to users as links only (REQ-SRC-010, REQ-SRC-011). Nothing is downloaded or embedded. These are never policy evidence and never cited as a fact source. URLs were checked against the 2026-10-28 S02 snapshot (data/sources_manifest.json M00-M04). D-057: linking is limited to the private, locally run prototype.

resources.title: What is the HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter?
resources.display_when: The question is about what the HFE letter is or why it is needed, and the user has not started the HFE application.

resources.title: Apply for an HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) letter
resources.display_when: The question is about how or when to apply for the HFE letter (Steps 1 and 2, timing).

resources.title: Step 1: Check Preliminary HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE)
resources.display_when: The question is about starting the HFE application or Step 1 (preliminary eligibility check).

resources.title: Step 2: Apply for HDB Flat Eligibility (HFE) Letter
resources.display_when: The question is about Step 2 of the HFE application or uploading documents.
